subject: general
question: The function of a steering system is to convert the rotary movement of the steering wheel into:

options.text: angular velocity of the front wheels
angular tum of the front wheels
angular turns of the rear wheels
linear motion of the front wheels

solution:
The correct answer is __angular tum of the front wheels.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The function of a steering system__ is to control the direction of the vehicle by turning the front wheels.
 
• The steering wheel's rotary motion is converted into the angular turn of the front wheels through linkages.
 
• This allows the vehicle to navigate curves and change direction safely.
 
• The primary purpose is to maintain control and stability of the vehicle while driving.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Angular velocity of the front wheels:**

 
 
• It refers to the rate of rotation of the wheels but is not a function of the steering system.
 
 
 
• **Angular turns of the rear wheels:**
 
 
• The rear wheels do not turn in most vehicles, except in some four-wheel steering systems.
 
 
 
• **Linear motion of the front wheels:**
 
 
• This refers to the forward or backward movement of the wheels, which is controlled by the engine and transmission, not the steering system.
